title: AERF-EVIDENCE Receipt
description: Agent Evidence Receipt Format — EVIDENCE profile, v0.1.0-draft.1. DRAFT — not yet stable. See SPEC.md §4 for the normative description.

id.description: Receipt identifier (UUIDv4 in v0.1; identifier format under review per held decision C-15).

type.description: Receipt profile discriminator. v0.1 ships only 'notarised_evidence'.

plan_id.description: UUIDv4 of the plan receipt this evidence references.

agent.description: Asserted identity of the acting agent.

action.description: Action being notarised. Charset: A-Z a-z 0-9 _ : . -

in_policy.description: Whether the action satisfied the plan's policy at observation time.

policy_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the policy decision.

evidence_hash_sha512.description: SHA-512 hex digest of the canonical JSON encoding of the 'evidence' object. Algorithm declared via field-name suffix per locked decision C-3; see SPEC.md §6.2.

evidence.description: Inline evidence payload. Inlining is the v0.1 default (privacy considerations apply — see held decision C-8 and SPEC.md §4.5).

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action was observed. Self-reported in the base profile; production profile MUST anchor with RFC 3161 (locked decision C-11).

key_id.description: Identifier of the issuer's public key. v0.1 uses the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256(public_key) per held decision C-9.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the receipt with 'signature' and 'timestamp' fields removed. Hex-encoded, 128 chars.

previous_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical PAYLOAD of the previous receipt in this plan's chain (locked decision C-7 — payload only, signature excluded). On the genesis receipt of a chain this field MUST be omitted entirely (locked decision C-6); presence with null or empty value is a conformance error in stable v0.1.

plan_signature.description: Hex-encoded Ed25519 signature of the referenced plan receipt, copied for receipt→plan binding.

agent_signature.description: Optional second signature by the acting agent's own key (held decision C-12).

agent_key_id.description: Key ID of the agent's signing key, when agent_signature is present.

policy_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of canonical {scope, checkpoints, delegates_to} of the plan.

output_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of canonical action output, when supplied.

session_trajectory.description: Recent action trace within the session (truncated by the issuer).

session_escalation.description: Escalation marker emitted by the session policy.

reasoning_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the UTF-8 reasoning text, when captured.

aiuc_controls.description: DEPRECATED — superseded by 'compliance_tags' per locked decision C-14. Will be removed by v1.0.

compliance_tags.description: Generic compliance tags (locked decision C-14). Replaces 'aiuc_controls'.

timestamp.description: RFC 3161 timestamp token information. REQUIRED for the production profile (locked decision C-11), OPTIONAL in the base profile.
